snippet.title: Fred's Idle Garden - A cozy idle-farming simulator
snippet.description:
*Wishlist on Steam* https://store.steampowered.com/app/3786640/Freds_Idle_Garden/

Fred's Idle Garden is an idle farming simulator which sits on your desktop while you do other things. 

*Grow & harvest crops* 🥕🌽🍅🥒
Grow various crops and watch the coins roll in! Use your shiny earnings to unlock even more crops, upgrade your characters abilities and buy some nice decorations for your garden. 

*Decorate your garden* 🌳🌼🌷🌵
Decorate your garden with plants and trees to create your own cozy little place. 

*Fully automated* ♾️ 👨‍🌾👩‍🌾
Fred's Idle Garden is a great game for multitaskers! Your character does all the hard work while you do your own thing. You can place the game wherever you want on your screen, zoom in and out, and it'll quietly do its thing without getting in your way. When you feel like it get back and add new things to your garden or upgrade your character.

#PrettyFlyGames #FredsIdleGarden #Indiegame #MadeWithUnity
